stories.headline: eBay Board Rejects GameStop's $56B Takeover as 'Neither Credible Nor Attractive'

key_facts.fact: eBay's board concluded GameStop's unsolicited $125-per-share, half cash/half stock proposal valuing the company at roughly $56B is 'neither credible nor attractive'.
key_facts.excerpt: EBay Inc. (Nasdaq: EBAY) has rejected an unsolicited acquisition proposal from GameStop, stating that the company's Board of Directors has concluded that the proposal is neither credible nor attractive.

key_facts.fact: The board cited eBay's standalone prospects, uncertainty over GameStop's financing, leverage and operational risks of the combined entity, and leadership structure concerns.
key_facts.excerpt: Factors such as eBay's standalone prospects, uncertainty regarding GameStop's financing proposal, the impact of the proposal on eBay's long-term growth and profitability, the leverage, operational risks, and leadership structure of a combined entity.

key_facts.fact: GameStop, with a market value around $11–12B and roughly $9.4B in cash and liquid investments, had a 'highly-confident letter' from TD Securities for up to $20B, leaving an unfunded gap of about $16B on the $56B deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Cohen said GameStop had about $9.4 billion in cash and liquid investments as of January 31 ... GameStop has 'a highly-confident letter from TD Securities for up to $20 billion' ... leaving a gap of $16 billion to complete the $56 billion deal.

key_facts.fact: GameStop's CEO Ryan Cohen had said he is prepared to take the offer directly to shareholders in a proxy fight if eBay's board rejected it.
key_facts.excerpt: Cohen told the Journal he is prepared to take the offer directly to shareholders in a proxy fight if necessary. Should the deal close, Cohen is expected to serve as Chief Executive Officer of the combined company.

stories.headline: Helsing Closing $1.2B Round at $18B Valuation, Largest German Startup Raise on Record

key_facts.fact: Munich-based defense AI startup Helsing is closing on a $1.2B funding round led by Dragoneer Investment Group with existing backer Lightspeed Venture Partners as co-lead, at an ~$18B valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: Five-year-old European military drone startup Helsing is reportedly close to raising a new $1.2 billion round at about an $18 billion valuation. The round is expected to be led by Dragoneer and co-led by existing Helsing investor Lightspeed.

key_facts.fact: The new valuation is roughly 30% above the €12B (~$14B) implied in Helsing's June 2025 Series D led by Daniel Ek's Prima Materia.
key_facts.excerpt: The current valuation would be around 30 percent above the €12 billion at which Helsing was last valued in June 2025 following a Series D led by Daniel Ek's Prima Materia.

key_facts.fact: The round would be the largest ever raised by a German startup, eclipsing Celonis's $1B in 2021 and N26's $900M the same year.
key_facts.excerpt: It would, however, be the largest funding round ever raised by a German startup. For comparison: Celonis reached one billion dollars in 2021, N26 $900 million in the same year.

key_facts.fact: Despite US firms leading the round, Helsing remains roughly 80% European-owned, positioning it as a sovereign European alternative to Anduril.
key_facts.excerpt: Despite US firms leading the round, Helsing remains roughly 80% European-owned.

key_facts.fact: The round was reportedly oversubscribed multiple times and comes amid an active €1.46B drone contract with the German military.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was oversubscribed multiple times, and comes with an active €1.46 billion drone contract with the German military.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Bizengri for NRG1-Fusion Bile Duct Cancer, 7th Drug Under Priority Voucher Program

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Partner Therapeutics' Bizengri (zenocutuzumab-zbco) for adults with advanced, unresectable or metastatic NRG1 fusion-positive cholangiocarcinoma after progression on prior therapy — the first targeted therapy for the indication.
key_facts.excerpt: FDA has approved BIZENGRI (zenocutuzumab-zbco) for the treatment of adults with advanced, unresectable or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a neuregulin 1 (NRG1) gene fusion ... the first targeted therapy approved specifically for NRG1+ cholangiocarcinoma.

key_facts.fact: Approval was expedited through the FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher program — the seventh drug approved under the new pilot.
key_facts.excerpt: This approval marks the seventh approval under the Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV) pilot program.

key_facts.fact: The decision was based on the open-label, single-arm eNRGy trial of 22 patients (19 evaluable) showing a 36.8% confirmed overall response rate and duration of response of 2.8–12.9 months.
key_facts.excerpt: The efficacy of Bizengri was evaluated in a single-arm trial of 19 patients with NRG1 fusion-positive cholangiocarcinoma of which 36.8% had an overall response. The duration of response ranged from 2.8 months to 12.9 months.

key_facts.fact: Bizengri previously received accelerated approval in 2024 for NRG1-fusion non-small cell lung cancer and pancreatic adenocarcinoma after prior systemic therapy.
key_facts.excerpt: In 2024, Bizengri received accelerated approval for the treatment of adults with advanced unresectable or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer and pancreatic adenocarcinoma harboring a NRG1 gene fusion.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Roche's Ocrevus for Children 10 and Older With Relapsing-Remitting MS

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Roche/Genentech's Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) for children 10 and older weighing at least 25 kg with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis — only the second therapy formally approved for pediatric MS in the US.
key_facts.excerpt: The FDA has approved the infusion therapy Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) for treating children with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) who are ages 10 and older and weigh at least 55 pounds (25 kg) ... the second-ever therapy to win formal FDA approval for this indication.

key_facts.fact: Approval rested mainly on the Phase 3 OPERETTA 2 trial in 187 children and adolescents comparing Ocrevus head-to-head with Gilenya (fingolimod) over two years.
key_facts.excerpt: The new FDA approval for the treatment of pediatric MS was based mainly on data from a Phase 3 clinical trial called OPERETTA 2 (NCT05123703), which enrolled 187 children and adolescents with MS.

key_facts.fact: Patients on Ocrevus had a 48% lower risk of relapse versus oral Gilenya, with a 48% reduction in new or enlarging lesions and 87% fewer actively inflamed lesions.
key_facts.excerpt: Patients treated with Ocrevus had a 48% lower risk of relapse compared with those receiving the oral medication ... Ocrevus significantly reduced the number of patients with new or enlarging MS lesions by 48% and also lowered the number of participants with actively inflamed lesions by 87%.

key_facts.fact: No participants discontinued Ocrevus due to side effects in the trial, while three withdrew on Gilenya; the safety profile was consistent with adult experience.
key_facts.excerpt: No side effects led to treatment discontinuation in the Ocrevus group, whereas three participants withdrew in the Gilenya group.

sources.title: FDA approves Ocrevus for treating kids 10 and older with RRMS

stories.headline: US-Brokered Ukraine-Russia Three-Day Truce Expires; Drone Strikes Resume After Midnight

key_facts.fact: The three-day US-mediated ceasefire that ran from May 9 to May 11 expired after midnight on May 12, with Russian and Ukrainian monitoring channels reporting combat drone launches resuming almost immediately.
key_facts.excerpt: After midnight on May 12, the truce between Ukraine and Russia, which was supposed to last on May 9, 10, and 11, expired ... Shortly after the ceasefire ended, monitoring channels from both sides began reporting the launch of combat drones.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said on May 11 that Russia is preparing new attacks and reported the Ukrainian general staff had logged 133 attacks and nearly 5,000 drone launches across the front during the truce period.
key_facts.excerpt: Enemy launched nearly 5,000 drones and carried out 133 attacks - General Staff on the situation at the front ... Russia does not plan to end the war and is preparing new attacks - Zelenskyy 11.05.26

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha proposed Europe broker an 'airport ceasefire' restricting strikes on each side's airfields, after US-led talks stalled amid the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine's Foreign Minister, Andrii Sybiha, has suggested that Europe may increase its role in the Russia-Ukraine peace process by helping to broker an 'airport ceasefire' in which both sides agree to halt strikes on each other's airfields.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Ukrainian negotiator Rustem Umerov met US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Florida and discussed 'possible formats of meetings at the leadership level' to end the war.
key_facts.excerpt: Zelensky reported that Umerov met with the US leader's special envoy, Steve Witkoff, and the US leader's son-in-law, Jared Kushner ... 'Possible formats of meetings and negotiations at the leadership level were discussed in the United States.'

stories.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Not Invited on Trump's China Trip as White House Pivots to Boeing, Soybeans

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was not invited to join President Trump's May 13–15 trip to Beijing, a person familiar with the matter said.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is not going to Beijing during President Donald Trump's trip to China this week, a person familiar with the matter said on Monday. Huang was not invited.

key_facts.fact: The White House delegation is focused on agriculture and commercial aviation deliverables — including potential Boeing aircraft orders and large Chinese soybean, beef and poultry purchases.
key_facts.excerpt: Huang was not invited, the source said, with the White House focusing more on agriculture and commercial aviation matters, such as orders for Boeing planes, on the current trip.

key_facts.fact: Confirmed CEO travel companions include Elon Musk (Tesla), Tim Cook (Apple), Larry Fink (BlackRock), Kelly Ortberg (Boeing), Larry Culp (GE Aerospace), Jane Fraser (Citigroup) and Cristiano Amon (Qualcomm).
key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump has invited executives from some of the biggest U.S. companies — including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Apple CEO Tim Cook, BlackRock's CEO Larry Fink and Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg— to join his trip to China this week.

key_facts.fact: Trump previously cleared Nvidia's H200 AI chips for export to China, but Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said on April 22 that no sales have occurred because Chinese buyers lack permission from Beijing.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump has developed a strong relationship with Huang since he has been in office and agreed to allow the company's H200 AI chips to be exported to China. But they have not yet been sold, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said on April 22nd.

key_facts.fact: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged China to pressure Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, accusing Beijing of 'funding terrorism' by continuing to buy Iranian oil.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called on China to pressure Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz, and said that by buying Iranian oil, Beijing is funding terrorism.

stories.headline: Aetherflux Rebrands as Cowboy Space, Raises $275M Series B at $2B for Orbital Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Cowboy Space Corporation — the rebranded Aetherflux founded by Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt — closed a $275M Series B at a $2B post-money valuation led by Index Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: The company announced the closure of a $275 million Series B round at a post-money valuation of $2 billion, led by earlier backer Index Ventures.

key_facts.fact: New investors IVP, Blossom Capital and SAIC joined existing backers Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Interlagos and Bhatt himself.
key_facts.excerpt: $275M in Series B financing at a $2B valuation led by Index Ventures, with participation from new investors IVP, Blossom Capital, and SAIC, alongside existing investors Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Interlagos and Baiju Bhatt.

key_facts.fact: The company is pivoting from space-to-Earth solar power transmission to in-orbit compute, designing rockets whose upper stage doubles as a 1-megawatt data center.
key_facts.excerpt: Cowboy Space has designed the rocket's upper stage and data center to be a single vehicle, unlike a traditional rocket that delivers a separate payload to space. Once in orbit, the upper stage will operate as a 1 megawatt data center.

key_facts.fact: Bhatt told TechCrunch the company plans its first satellite launch this year and first proprietary rocket no earlier than the end of 2028, framed as a response to a shortage of launch capacity for space data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We're standing up our own rocket program,' Baiju Bhatt, the CEO and founder of Cowboy Space Corporation, told TechCrunch. He expects the first launch before the end of 2028.

key_facts.fact: Cowboy Space had previously raised about $80M in earlier rounds since its 2024 founding as Aetherflux.
key_facts.excerpt: The company had previously raised $80 million from investors, including Index, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, and New Enterprise Associates.
